novelty.justification: The claim's central novelty is the proposed developmental relationship that "the pretraining checkpoint at which a belief becomes linearly decodable predicts the checkpoint at which that belief becomes context-unrevisable," supplemented by the mechanism that consolidation of parametric recall causes declining context reliance. Searches for "pretraining checkpoints factual acquisition context conflict override," "belief entrenchment RAG checkpoint," and "parametric knowledge suppression FFN context faithfulness" identify On Linear Representations and Pretraining Data Frequency in Language Models as closest on representation emergence and ParamMute: Suppressing Knowledge-Critical FFNs for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation as closest on suppressing parametric recall to restore contextual faithfulness, but neither studies per-fact acquisition-to-entrenchment timing across pretraining. Connecting those two established lines is more than a direct transfer because it posits a new checkpoint-coupling relationship, although the consolidation-circuit intervention is partly anticipated by ParamMute; this supports high novelty within an existing framework rather than a new paradigm.
